label: Act is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 to POTENCY_2 at a first being, from esse-cause priority (inference)
rule: Reductio at the supposed first being, as in firstBeingNoPotencyOfEssePriority; the first-being version then holds vacuously
meaning: The first-being version of act priority from the same four premises: by firstBeingNoPotencyOfEssePriority a first being is in potency in no respect, so the first-being version holds vacuously.
